_note: The screens' vocabulary (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-device-screens.md): the draw items, actions and values ui/screens.js may use, which device.js (the mock) and the device's UI runtime both implement. device.js's problems() and tools/screens/gen.py refuse anything outside it. Adding a word here means implementing it twice: in device.js and in app/ui. items: a draw item's kind (the key that names it) and every key it may carry, in the order the generator numbers them (ui_item_kind). actions: an action's kind ({ go } or { do }) and its other keys (ui_action, after UA_NONE). values: the names a template ({name}) or a condition (when) may read: fixed ones, and patterns: {a-b} a number in that range, {field} a key of screens.js's fields, {row} a row id of rows.js, {line} a key of screens.js's lines.
